source: Margin Tide is a fictional independent stationery studio. Its new notebook, Fieldline, has an A5 paper format and three printed section headings: Notice, Sketch, and Revisit. Its cover is moss green. The notebook is intended for people who enjoy observing everyday places and making informal notes. These are the only confirmed product specifications. A separate event called A Page Outside is a 28-minute live online demonstration by studio founder Rowan. Rowan will demonstrate using Fieldline with an imaginary neighbourhood square as the example. The 28 minutes is only the event duration, not a promise of improved creativity, observation, productivity or wellbeing. No event date, price, product price, page count, paper weight, recycled content, binding type, weather resistance, delivery arrangements, downloadable materials, recordings, attendee limit, qualifications, customer testimonials or measured outcomes have been announced. Do not invent them or additional event activities. Current notebook information replaces the old saved brand offer of a waterproof travel journal. Create engaging awareness content about the three headings and the freedom to leave a page unfinished. Clearly hypothetical notes about an imaginary square are welcome as creative examples, not product features, event curriculum or customer experiences. Avoid publisher-facing instructions. No CTA anywhere, including captions, questions, scripts and hashtags: no requests to book, buy, visit, click, follow, save, share, comment, message or subscribe. Leave CTA suggestion items empty with a short neutral explanation. Keep each asset concise while retaining every requested format.
audience: Adults who enjoy everyday observation, informal sketching and paper notebooks
offer: Outdated saved brand detail: a waterproof travel journal. Superseded by the current Fieldline brief; no weather resistance is confirmed.
contentGoal: Awareness of Fieldline and its three printed headings without inventing specifications or promising personal outcomes.
